title: Adaptive version transition playbook and replay lab for streaming, calls, and structured outputs
creator: Asha Raman
description: Context: We need a single operational playbook that choreographs model/API version rollouts that affect streaming responses, tool/function calling contracts, and the structured-output schema. Past migrations have caused client breakage when streaming chunk shapes changed or when subtle behavior flags toggled new default parser semantics. This ticket owns the product-side coordination, migration guidance artifacts, and a replayable lab harness for deterministic backward-compat tests. The outcome should be a repeatable, low-friction migration path (shadow/dual-run -> staged client waves -> sunset) that reduces regression surface and provides clear rollback/fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook published in Confluence with step-by-step runbook for canary, canary->regional->global rollouts
Replay lab (seeded corpus + recorder) that can re-run production traffic deterministically against old and new API variants
Automated compatibility test suite that covers: streaming chunk boundaries, function-call signature stability, required/optional structured-output fields, and schema evolution rules
SDK migration snippets and a customer-facing migration guide with code examples for streaming fallbacks and function-call shims
Monitoring dashboards live showing client-side error rate, parsing failures, guidance signals (client adoption %), and cost delta during each phase
Rollback triggers and runbook verified by a tabletop drill with infra/eng/support participants
tasks: Consolidate known incompatibility patterns with Applied ML + Runtime (list of 10 representative regression cases)
Design replay lab spec: input corpus selection, deterministic RNG seed policy, KV-cache priming approach
Build a dual-run proxy mode in staging to record discrepancies between old/new runtime variants
Define behavior-flag matrix and recommended deprecation timing (grace, warnings, hard-deprecate)
Author migration guide (confluence) with step-by-step SDK changes and troubleshooting FAQ
Create observability dashboard templates (client errors, compatibility drift, token-level latency/cost delta)
Coordinate SRE tabletop and document post-mortem checklist for rollback sequence

communication_plan: Customer-facing: 60-day advance notice for behavioral deprecations, migration guide + SDK samples, in-console deprecation banner with 'test in console' button. Internal: weekly sync with Runtime, SDK, SRE, Docs; post-mortem and learnings tracked in retro doc.
rollout_phases: Phase 0 - Shadow validation: Dual-run in staging + replay lab against seeded corpus
Phase 1 - Field pilot: opt-in customers (10%) with explicit migration support
Phase 2 - Regional gradual rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 60% with 48h observation windows
Phase 3 - Global default: behavior flag flips for remaining traffic, deprecation warnings emitted
Phase 4 - Sunset: hard deprecation after agreed grace period and customer confirmations
risk_mitigation: Provide per-client compatibility adapters (server-side shims) for the highest-value customers; maintain a 'compatibility-bridge' runtime variant for 12 months post-sunset. Establish automated replay on any regression detection and keep a fast rollback path.
